# expect: # Tab-separated. branch: main | feat (feat is feat/x). cwd is relative to the project: . | sub | tests.
# The command column goes through @PROJECT@ substitution, then printf '%b' (so \n is a newline and \\ a backslash).

command: cd sub && git push origin main
env GIT_TRACE=1 git push origin main
if true; then git push -f; fi
git switch main && git reset --hard origin/main
git checkout main -- README.md && git push
git checkout main && git checkout -b feat/y && git push -u origin HEAD
git checkout main && git switch --create feat/y && git push -u origin HEAD
